title: Duality Theory for Non-Markovian Linear Gaussian Models
summary: This work develops a duality theory for partially observed linear Gaussian models in discrete time. The state process evolves according to a causal but non-Markovian (or higher-order Gauss-Markov) structure, captured by a lower-triangular transition operator, which is related to transformer, with $T$ as the context length.
